name: A2A Commerce Gateway
description: Agent-to-agent commerce infrastructure: billing, payments, escrow, marketplace, identity, messaging, and trust scoring

authentication.description: API key via Authorization: Bearer a2a_{tier}_{key} header. Free tier available (500 credits, 100 req/hr).

skills.name: Billing & Wallets
skills.description: Agent wallets, credit deposits/withdrawals, usage tracking, budget caps, volume discounts, currency exchange, and leaderboards

skills.name: Payments & Escrow
skills.description: Payment intents (authorize/capture), standard and performance-gated escrow, subscriptions, split payments, and refunds

skills.name: Identity & Reputation
skills.description: Ed25519 cryptographic agent identity, verifiable claims, metric commitments, organizations, and reputation scoring

skills.name: Service Marketplace
skills.description: Service registration, discovery, matching, ratings, and strategy comparison

skills.name: Trust Scoring
skills.description: Composite trust scores, SLA compliance checking, and server search

skills.name: Agent Messaging
skills.description: End-to-end encrypted agent-to-agent messaging and price negotiation

skills.name: Dispute Resolution
skills.description: Dispute lifecycle management: open, respond, resolve, with 7-day response deadline

skills.name: Infrastructure
skills.description: API key management, webhook registration with HMAC-signed delivery, event bus with schema registry, audit logging, and database operations
